card.name: Aiming a stream at a target
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, onto, against, at) right after a verb or phrase of aiming or directing something, such as a stream of diluent or a weapon. Mostly in reconstitution steps, also in shooting scenes.

modes.label: Directing diluent
modes.description: Preposition or 'the' after directing a stream of sterile water or diluent toward a vial wall or powder.
modes.example: Direct the stream of Sterile Water for Injection vertically<< onto>> the center of the lyophilized powder

modes.label: Aiming a device or weapon
modes.description: Linking word after aiming, firing or jabbing something at a target, as in injector instructions or fiction.
modes.example: Aim and firmly jab the Black Tip straight down (at a 90° angle) against<< the>> mid-lateral thigh.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that follows a verb of aiming or directing, just before the target is named, such as the vial wall.
